watch.summary: A streamer passionately roots for 100 Thieves during a Valorant match, only to hold his head in despair when the sole enemy player clutches a 1v3.

beats.what: Streamer shouts hyping up his team during a Valorant match.
Streamer pulls out a 100 Thieves jersey to wear/display for good luck.
Streamer yells at the screen, begging 100T to swarm the last enemy standing in a 1v3.
The enemy player clutches the 1v3 and wins the round.
Streamer puts his hands on his head screaming in utter agony and disbelief.
Streamer rants about how scared his team played during the clutch.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: WHY are we giving him a 1v3?!
watch.why: The comedic appeal comes from the classic fan agony experience, where the streamer pulls out team merch for luck only to watch them immediately choke an easy 3v1 advantage.
